int64

int64
REQUIRED

int32

Possible values: >= 0

Page number (0-based)

int32

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 100

Page size (1-100)

Default value: 10

string

Field to sort by. Default: policyName. Sortable fields: id, policyType, policyName, violations.

Default value: policyName
sortDir
string

ASC or DESC. Default: ASC.

Default value: ASC
